definitions.explanation: The biological process by which insects, reptiles, and other animals shed their outer skin or shell as they grow.

definitions.gloss: outgrowing; breaking free from; shedding (old ways)
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the act of breaking free from old habits, limitations, or an outdated state and developing into something new.

ヘビ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{脱皮|だっぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。

notes:
Composed of {脱|だつ} (remove, escape) + {皮|ひ} (skin). Literally means to remove one's skin. The biological sense is the primary meaning, but the figurative sense of shedding old ways is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱皮|だっぴ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to molt repeatedly)
- {脱皮|だっぴ}⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧ (just after molting)
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{脱皮|だっぴ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shed the old constitution/ways)
- ⟦{旧来|きゅうらい}→旧来：13155_kyuurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{脱皮|だっぴ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to break out of the old shell)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧ — emergence (of an adult insect from pupa); a specific stage, not general skin shedding
- ⟦{脱却|だっきゃく}→脱却：13944_dakkyaku⟧ — breaking free, escaping (figurative only); more formal and abstract
- ⟦{変革|へんかく}→変革：12100_henkaku⟧ — reform, transformation; broader and more institutional

USAGE:
The figurative use is especially common in business and personal development contexts, where {脱皮|だっぴ} vividly conveys the idea of leaving behind an old self and emerging renewed.
